game.name: New Super Mario Bros. Wii
game.rules:
All runs must be done on an official New Super Mario Bros. Wii release. Hacked save files, Gecko codes, and other game modifications are not allowed. Using any USB loader or any emulator isn't allowed.

Runs performed on Wii or WiiU using a disc are submitted to the "Physical" subcategory. Runs performed on WiiU Virtual Console are submitted to the "Digital" subcategory.

For all full-game runs, your finished run must be able to trigger the credits (i.e. not dying in lava after hitting the final switch in 8-C).

Outside of Any% Multiplayer, Multiplayer is banned.

All runs require video proof. Runs submitted before August 12th, 2020 will remain untouched. Game audio is highly recommended, especially for runs retimed without loads, but is not required. Uploading runs to YouTube is highly recommended.

Please, for the sake of the mods, make the start of the run line up with the start of the video. Otherwise, your submission may be rejected. Ideally, the run should include the final moment of the previous run and start at latest at the player select screen. If using any sort of super guide manip, that should be included in the recording.

We try our best to process run verification within a few days but sometimes it takes a little longer, please be patient. We also have lives off of the site.

For any other questions about rules, join our [discord](https://discord.gg/XfGPJmp) and ask a moderator!

categories.name: Any%
categories.rules:
Beat the game, no restrictions.

Timing starts on first non-pause input (pressing right to move to 1-1 on the world map, pressing A to view the world map, pressing 1 to open the item inventory or pressing - to view other worlds) and ends upon touching the button at the end of Bowser's Castle.

Runs under 25:00 done on disc are ranked without loads and using milliseconds in the LRT column. All other times are ranked with loads in the RTA column. 

Before submitting a run, please carefully read the "Game rules" tab.

categories.name: Cannonless
categories.rules:
Beat the game without using warp cannons.

Pipes and other shortcuts on the world map are allowed.

Timing starts on first non-pause input (pressing right to move to 1-1 on the world map, pressing A to view the world map, pressing 1 to open the item inventory or pressing - to view other worlds) and ends upon touching the button at the end of Bowser's Castle.

All times are ranked with loads in the RTA column.

Before submitting a run, please carefully read the "Game rules" tab.

Beat the game with 100% completion (5 stars on the file select screen). This requires collecting all star coins (including World 9) and taking all cannons.

Timing starts on first non-pause input (pressing right to move to 1-1 on the world map, pressing A to view the world map, pressing 1 to open the item inventory or pressing - to view other worlds) and ends when the "You have completed everything in New Super Mario Bros. Wii!" message appears.

All times are ranked with loads in the RTA column.

Before submitting a run, please carefully read the "Game rules" tab.

categories.name: Any% No W5
categories.rules:
Beat the game without entering World 5.

Timing starts on first non-pause input (pressing right to move to 1-1 on the world map, pressing A to view the world map, pressing 1 to open the item inventory or pressing - to view other worlds) and ends upon touching the button at the end of Bowser's castle.

Runs under 46:00 done on disc are ranked without loads and using milliseconds in the LRT column. All other times are ranked with loads in the RTA column. 

Before submitting a run, please carefully read the "Game rules" tab.

categories.name: Low%
categories.rules:
Beat the game without power-ups, checkpoint flags, and Yoshis. Runs collecting any of these are automatically invalid.

Timing starts on first non-pause input (pressing right to move to 1-1 on the world map, pressing A to view the world map, pressing 1 to open the item inventory or pressing - to view other worlds) and ends upon touching the button at the end of Bowser's Castle.

Runs under 26:30 done on disc are ranked without loads and using milliseconds in the LRT column. All other times are ranked with loads in the RTA column. 

Before submitting a run, please carefully read the "Game rules" tab.

categories.name: Any% Multiplayer
categories.rules:
Beat the game on multiplayer mode.

1-4 people may participate in a run. There are no restrictions for how many controllers a single runner can use. When submitting runs completed by only one runner, select "No" for "Multiple Runners."

Swapping controllers between players is allowed. There are no restrictions regarding bubbling.

Timing starts on first non-pause input (pressing right to move to 1-1 on the world map, pressing A to view the world map, pressing 1 to open the item inventory or pressing - to view other worlds) and ends upon touching the button at the end of Bowser's Castle.

All times are ranked with loads in the RTA column.

Before submitting a run, please carefully read the "Game rules" tab.

categories.name: All Regular Exits
categories.rules:
Beat the game while completing every regular exit (not including secrets). This includes levels which are accessed via a secret, such as 8-7. World 9 is not included.

Timing starts on first non-pause input (pressing right to move to 1-1 on the world map, pressing A to view the world map, pressing 1 to open the item inventory or pressing - to view other worlds) and ends upon touching the button at the end of Bowser's Castle.

All times are ranked with loads in the RTA column. 

Before submitting a run, please carefully read the "Game rules" tab.

levels.name: World 1
levels.rules:
All Game Rules still apply with ILs and IWs.

**Individual Levels Rules**

Any%: Beat the level with no restrictions.

100%: Beat the level with all the star coins.

You may begin the IL with any power up except Superstar. Starting from checkpoint isn't allowed.

You can complete the level by using any exit.

IGT is used for timing. To get your submission time, subtract the initial time of the level at the start with the time when you end the level. **IGT must be visible, otherwise your submission will be rejected**. Screenshots are not accepted as proof (WR or not).

Using a super guide block to clear the level isn't allowed.

**Individual Worlds Rules**

Any%: Beat all levels necessary to reach 1-Castle and defeat Larry Koopa.

100%: Get all exits and all star coins. You do not have to go through the cannon.

Timing starts when you select 1-1. Timing ends when you grab the key in the castle. *In 100%, you may end on a level other than 1-Castle if you prefer as long as no other rules are broken (ie. you may complete 1-Castle before 1-6 while following the proper paths). In this case, timing ends upon reaching the flagpole of the final level.*

In between levels, **you may only equip stocked items collected during the IW**, either from enemy ambush fights or toad houses “unlocked” and played during the IW. This is included in IW timing. **Equipping items between levels is otherwise banned**. You may begin the first level with any power up except Superstar.

**Levels must be completed in the order that they were intended** (i.e. using a route that would function from a new save file). This includes following the proper paths between levels. You may not leave the world during the run.

All runs can be done from a new or completed save file. Starting from a checkpoint isn't allowed.

runList.comment:
First 21:4x, and the first run that is fast enough to be a 21:xx even without the new strategy of ATC in 8-C. However, I have very mixed feelings about the run.

This is due to timeloss in 5-1 due to a missed pipekick (~0.5 seconds), missing donut jump in 5-3 which also makes wss impossible (~0.9 seconds), ~0.8 seconds of general timeloss in 8-A due to sloppy movement, and finally ~1.6 seconds of timeloss due to mistakes in 8-C.

There were also some smaller timelosses found in 5-GH first room, 8-2 turnaround, 8-1 shellboost and pipe entry, 8-7 jump exits, and some even more minor timelosses found in most levels not mentioned.

Despite all of these mistakes, I am happy to get a clean 1-1, 5-T and 5-4 in a run, as those are some of the hardest levels for me to get an optimal time in.

Due to burnout from Any%, I will not be continuing attempts of this category for a short while, as I need a break from the grind. I will be streaming other categories and other NSMB games in the meantime on my Twitch channel.

games.name: New Super Mario Bros. Wii
games.rules:
All runs must be done on an official New Super Mario Bros. Wii release. Hacked save files, Gecko codes, and other game modifications are not allowed. Using any USB loader or any emulator isn't allowed.

Runs performed on Wii or WiiU using a disc are submitted to the "Physical" subcategory. Runs performed on WiiU Virtual Console are submitted to the "Digital" subcategory.

For all full-game runs, your finished run must be able to trigger the credits (i.e. not dying in lava after hitting the final switch in 8-C).

Outside of Any% Multiplayer, Multiplayer is banned.

All runs require video proof. Runs submitted before August 12th, 2020 will remain untouched. Game audio is highly recommended, especially for runs retimed without loads, but is not required. Uploading runs to YouTube is highly recommended.

Please, for the sake of the mods, make the start of the run line up with the start of the video. Otherwise, your submission may be rejected. Ideally, the run should include the final moment of the previous run and start at latest at the player select screen. If using any sort of super guide manip, that should be included in the recording.

We try our best to process run verification within a few days but sometimes it takes a little longer, please be patient. We also have lives off of the site.

For any other questions about rules, join our [discord](https://discord.gg/XfGPJmp) and ask a moderator!

levels.name: World 4
levels.rules:
All Game Rules still apply with ILs and IWs.

**Individual Levels Rules**

Any%: Beat the level with no restrictions.

100%: Beat the level with all the star coins.

You may begin the IL with any power up except Superstar. Starting from checkpoint isn't allowed.

You can complete the level by using any exit.

IGT is used for timing. To get your submission time, subtract the initial time of the level at the start with the time when you end the level. **IGT must be visible, otherwise your submission will be rejected**. Screenshots are not accepted as proof (WR or not).

Using a super guide block to clear the level isn't allowed.

**Individual Worlds Rules**

Any%: Beat all levels necessary to reach 4-Airship and defeat Bowser Jr.

100%: Get all exits and all star coins. You do not have to go through the cannon.

Timing starts when you select 4-1. Timing ends when you defeat Bowser Jr. *In 100%, you may end on a level other than 4-Airship if you prefer as long as no other rules are broken (ie. you may complete 4-Airship before 4-3 while following the proper paths). In this case, timing ends upon reaching the flagpole of the final level.*

In between levels, **you may only equip stocked items collected during the IW**, either from enemy ambush fights or toad houses “unlocked” and played during the IW. This is included in IW timing. **Equipping items between levels is otherwise banned**. You may begin the first level with any power up except Superstar.

**Levels must be completed in the order that they were intended** (i.e. using a route that would function from a new save file). This includes following the proper paths between levels. You may not leave the world during the run.

All runs can be done from a new or completed save file. Starting from a checkpoint isn't allowed.
